# Skill: Version Tagging & Commit Standards
**Domain:** Version Control
**Scope:** SemVer implementation and commit lifecycle.

## Execution Parameters
* Enforce canonical Semantic Versioning (SemVer) for all repository tags.
* Baseline tag initialization: `0.1.0`.
* Commit standard: Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:`, `refactor:`, `docs:`).
* All commits must map accurately to the scope of work completed prior to pushing to the remote origin.
